moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 buzz builds
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing is generating excitement ahead of its launch show on September 19th, with the full celebrity line-up having been announced by August 12th.

angles.name: Pre-launch excitement
angles.copy: The Strictly Come Dancing launch is just weeks away! We're already buzzing about the celeb line-up and who'll be paired with whom. Who are you backing for the Glitterball? #Strictly

angles.name: New presenters
angles.copy: Big changes in the ballroom this year! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe are taking over hosting duties on Strictly. Ready for the new era?

moments.title: Robert Plant turns 78
moments.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant celebrates his 78th birthday on August 20th.

angles.name: Rock icon's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 78th to the golden god himself, Robert Plant! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track that showcases that iconic voice?

angles.name: Led Zeppelin tribute
angles.copy: From 'Stairway to Heaven' to 'Whole Lotta Love', Robert Plant's vocals defined an era. Celebrating his 78th today!

moments.title: Kim Cattrall's 70th Birthday
moments.blurb: British-Canadian actress Kim Cattrall, best known as Samantha Jones from 'Sex and the City', turns 70 on August 21st.

angles.name: Samantha Jones icon
angles.copy: Happy 70th Birthday to the one and only Kim Cattrall! Forever our favourite PR guru, Samantha Jones. What was her most iconic line?

angles.name: Liverpool born star
angles.copy: Liverpool-born star Kim Cattrall hits the big 7-0 today! From 'Mannequin' to 'Sex and the City', she's been a screen legend for decades.

moments.title: Dua Lipa turns 31
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday on August 22nd.

angles.name: Pop princess birthday
angles.copy: Happy 31st Birthday to the incredible Dua Lipa! From 'New Rules' to 'Dance The Night', her hits keep us moving. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Dua Lipa's impact
angles.copy: 31 years young and already a multiple Grammy winner! Dua Lipa's impact on pop and dance music is undeniable. Celebrate her birthday with her biggest tracks!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival weekend
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading and Leeds Festivals are expected to take place over the UK's August Bank Holiday weekend, bringing major acts to stages in Reading and Leeds. (Dates typically August 28-30 for 2026).

angles.name: Festival anticipation
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festival is just around the corner, kicking off the Bank Holiday weekend! Who's heading to the fields for some live music magic?

angles.name: Leeds local vibe
angles.copy: The countdown to Leeds Festival is on! Get ready for a huge weekend of music and mayhem in West Yorkshire. Who are you buzzing to see?

angles.name: Reading local vibe
angles.copy: Reading Festival is set to take over the Bank Holiday! Who's making the trip to Berkshire for one of the UK's biggest music events?

moments.title: Florence Welch turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence + The Machine frontwoman Florence Welch celebrates her 40th birthday on August 28th.

angles.name: Indie queen's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 40th to the ethereal and iconic Florence Welch! What's your go-to Florence + The Machine anthem?

angles.name: Celebrating a unique voice
angles.copy: From 'Lungs' to 'Dance Fever', Florence Welch has captivated us for years. Celebrating her 40th today and all the magic she brings!

moments.title: Shania Twain turns 61
moments.blurb: The 'Queen of Country Pop' Shania Twain celebrates her 61st birthday on August 28th.

angles.name: Country legend's birthday
angles.copy: Let's go girls! Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Shania Twain. What's your favourite hit from the Queen of Country Pop?

angles.name: Still the one
angles.copy: From 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!' to 'You're Still The One', Shania Twain's songs are timeless. Celebrating her 61st today!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday weekend
moments.blurb: The UK's last Bank Holiday until Christmas falls on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Bank Holiday plans
angles.copy: Who's already planning their August Bank Holiday weekend? The last one until Christmas – make it count!

angles.name: End of summer vibes
angles.copy: That bittersweet feeling when the August Bank Holiday signals the unofficial end of summer. What are your last summer hurrah plans?

moments.title: Back to school preparations
moments.blurb: Families across the UK are now in full swing with preparations for children returning to school in late August and early September.

angles.name: School uniform dash
angles.copy: The great back-to-school uniform dash is officially on! Are you organised or still scrambling for those last-minute essentials?

angles.name: Summer's nearly over
angles.copy: Parents everywhere are counting down the days until the kids are back at school! What's top of your to-do list before the new term starts?
